documents.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence Statement
documents.stance_why: The statement sets no ban or default itself: use "will follow existing University policies and procedures", unauthorized use goes to Academic Conduct Procedures, and students are told to "ask your instructors for clarification", which leaves what is authorized to instructors.
documents.summary: A short university-wide statement that frames AI as a research tool and subjects its use to existing policy. Students own what they submit, must document AI use, and face conduct procedures for unauthorized use; they should ask instructors when unsure.

units.why: Opening framing: AI is "a tool for innovative research and discovery across disciplines", the institution's view, so informs/encourage; P56 (institution-level principle) fits better than P44 since it does not speak of teaching professional skills.
units.anchor: considers artificial intelligence (AI) as a tool for innovative research and discovery across disciplines

units.why: "Use of generative AI tools by any member of the LIU community will follow existing University policies and procedures" binds everyone and sets the scope and framework; P56 fits as an institution-wide framework.
units.anchor: generative AI tools by any member of the LIU community will follow existing University policies

units.why: "You are responsible for the information you submit based on an AI query" makes students own what they submit, P29; the examples (IP, misinformation) are coded separately.
units.anchor: You are responsible for the information you submit based on an AI query

units.why: The parenthetical "does not violate intellectual property laws" asks students to ensure submitted AI content respects IP, P52 (copyright).
units.anchor: does not violate intellectual property laws
units.policy: Students ensure that information they submit based on an AI query does not violate intellectual property laws

units.why: "or contain misinformation or unethical content" requires students to ensure AI-based submissions are accurate and ethical; P31 (verify output) fits best since it concerns misinformation.
units.policy: Students ensure that information they submit based on an AI query does not contain misinformation or unethical content

units.why: "Your use of AI tools must be properly documented in accordance with university policies on academic honesty" requires documentation of AI use, P24 (disclose); no tool/prompt details so not P25.
units.anchor: must be properly documented in accordance with university policies on academic honesty

units.why: "found to have used generative AI tools in unauthorized ways will be subject to LIU's Academic Conduct Procedures" classes unauthorized use as misconduct handled by integrity process, P36.
units.anchor: used generative AI tools in unauthorized ways will be subject to LIU’s Academic Conduct Procedures

units.why: "When in doubt about permitted usage, please ask your instructors for clarification" tells unsure students to ask, P10.
units.anchor: When in doubt about permitted usage, please ask your instructors for clarification

notes: Only one thin university-level document included; no school, computing or course documents.
